comparison.objective: Set a proximity sensor gap using a feeler leaf and lock its clamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert a thin gauge, slide a sensor against it, close a cam clamp, extract and store the gauge.
comparison.success_condition: 1.00 mm gap within tolerance, clamp locked on the gauge-derived setting, leaf removed, hands clear; dangerously small locked gap fails.
comparison.reason: Precision gauging and clamp locking are materially different from granular-flow manipulation.
